prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical anime summer fashion collection poster for a delicate seaside resort look, featuring an original girl model and elegant magazine-style typography.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, airy white-and-pale-blue palette, high-key summer sunlight, soft watercolor anime rendering, sparkling ocean reflections, dreamy luxury resort mood.

Layout: Place the character large on the right and lower center, seated on a beach blanket with knees drawn up. Reserve the upper-left and left side for editorial text. Use oversized elegant serif typography for the main collection title, with smaller brand and coordinate information beneath it. Add a short poetic tagline near the bottom right.

Text content: At the upper left, show the brand name “Lumiétoile” with small decorative plus marks, then “Summer Collection 2025”. The large main title should read “Seaside Whisper”. Below it, add Japanese subtitle text “しずく色のリゾート”. Add three small information blocks: “COORDINATE” with “シーサイド・ドリームコーデ”, “BRAND” with “Lumiétoile”, and “MODEL” with “のぞむ” plus “Nozomu” in cursive. At the bottom right, add the poetic Japanese copy “風がそっと、秘密を連れてくる。”

Subject details: The model is Nozomu, a cute young anime girl with long soft charcoal-brown hair, straight bangs, translucent blue eyes with starry highlights, pale skin, and a shy blushing expression. She holds one hand near her mouth in a bashful pose. Add a white-and-blue floral hair accessory on the right side of her hair with dangling pearl chains, blue gems, ribbons, and seashell-like ornaments. Her outfit is a white and very pale ice-blue off-shoulder summer resort dress with lace trim, sheer ruffled sleeves, ribbon bows, delicate corset details, soft layered fabric, and matching long translucent fingerless gloves. Include dainty ankle ribbons and lace details.

Environment and props: Set the scene on a bright beach with a sparkling blue ocean behind her, distant low mountains on the horizon, a pale sky with soft clouds, bubbles, lens-flare-like water sparkles, and white seagulls in the upper right. Add beach accessories around her: exactly 4 visible props — a clear glass bottle with a pale blue ribbon at the lower left, a small stack of round shells or containers beside it, a tall blue sparkling drink with a straw at the lower right, and seashells with a blue beach ball near the lower right edge.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed Japanese anime illustration, soft pastel watercolor, luminous backlighting, fine lace and fabric rendering, glossy eyes, delicate linework, transparent sea-glass colors, editorial fashion poster design, elegant serif fonts, romantic summer atmosphere.

Constraints: Keep all typography clean and readable, do not add extra people, preserve exactly one main character, maintain the left-side fashion-poster text hierarchy, avoid dark or heavy colors, no watermark, no logo other than the fictional brand name.
